Commentary.Commentary: Update 1414 local - Good news. The rain has stopped and the covers are off. The players are walking on the field and we are all set to resume. Join us on the other side.
Update 1354 local - It will be a delayed start to this session as tweeted by Cricket Australia. Although the good news is that the covers are starting to come off. Stay tuned.
Update 1324 local - It is pelting down out there. We though still have time for Lunch to get over. Let us hope it passes away and we resume on time.

Hang on! The players were out in the middle and then the umpires decided to go off for LUNCH. Tim Paine is seen arguing with the officials. Maybe, he's expressing his disappointment. Australia kept on batting under the drizzle and when it's India's turn, they have decided to go off. The visitors won't complain. Do join us in a short while for the afternoon session.

A good bowling performance as a unit by India. They started on an ordinary note yesterday morning but quickly hit the right chords. Ishant, Shami and Bumrah bowled with a lot of intensity while Ashwin also impressed one and all by picking a 3-wicket haul. They now have got a little advantage and would like to bat better than their first innings to swell the lead. Stay tuned, the Indian openers will be out soon.

Australia's weakest suit is their batting and that once again let them down. However, there was a marked improvement shown by the lower-middle order, in terms of willingness to stick around and gut it out. Peter Handscomb and Travis Head batted decently and Australia would hope for their top order to come good while batting last.

So, finally India have managed to bowl out Australia but not before they reduced the deficit down to 15 runs. The 31-run stand between Travis Head and Nathan Lyon was the need of the hour for the Aussies and they won't be too disappointed at the moment. A word of praise for Head. He played a beautiful patient knock to equal his best Test score and proved that his Test saving innings in Dubai wasn't an aberration.

OUT! India have the lead! Shami takes two in two. Another loose shot. It is short and outside off, Hazlewood throws his bat at it, gets an outside edge and Pant behind does the rest. Poor Lyon is left stranded. AUSTRALIA BOWLED OUT FOR 235!
Josh Hazlewood is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Shami gets the well-set Travis Head. He does not surpass his highest score. But a very important knock by him comes to an end. Shami bowls it outside off and it is on a length. Head maybe should have left the delivery but he ends up chasing it away from his body. The ball takes the outside edge and goes into the hands of Pant who accepts it. The bowling change has worked and the Indians will be relieved to break this stand. Australia are still 15 runs behind and have only a wicket in hand.
Now works it with the angle towards square leg and takes a single.

SIX! TAKEN! In the crowd that is! What a shot by Lyon. He says, enough of ducking under short balls. Takes on the challenge of pulling it, connects well and it sails over the square leg fence. Lyon is playing a gem here.
Double bowling change. Mohammed Shami is into the attack.
Fires it on off, it is the carrom ball again, straightens a touch. Lyon tries to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point for a run.
Head straightaway dances down the track and works it towards Pujara at mid-wicket. He misfields and a run is taken. Head has now equalled his highest score in Tests.
The carrom ball on middle, Lyon flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
FOUR! Lyon brings out the shot which he loves the most, the sweep shot. Does not get it off the middle as it flies off the top edge to the fine leg fence. The trail is only 25 now.
Flatter and on middle, Lyon pushes it back to the bowler.
Ravichandran Ashwin is on.
That was clipped away right off the middle, it went quickly to the man at deep square leg. A run taken, which means Lyon will be on strike again.
Hit on the up to the man at mid off.
Just like that! However, this one was a good delivery. It was first angled around off, then leaves the batsman after pitching. Lyon has a poke at it and gets beaten.
Back of a length around middle, Lyon nudges it towards mid-wicket. He has played the balls bowled on the stumps well, it is only the balls bowled outside off which he has to stop fetching.
Around middle and off, Lyon plays it with a closed face towards mid-wicket.
Another bouncer to Lyon, he has no problems in ducking under it.
Shot! Another triple! Bumrah is guilty of bowling a little too full here. Lyon strokes it through mid off and takes three.
No yorker, bowls it on a length around off, the batsman is solid in defense.
Top class bouncer! Nathan does really well to duck under it. It was fast and well-directed. A yorker now to follow it up? Lyon will surely be expecting one.
Shuffles across and then works it with the angle through square leg for another single.
Good length on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length around off, Head pushes it to covers.
Revised session times (in local time) - 1st session - 1230-1330, Lunch - 1330-1410, 2nd session - 1410-1625, Tea - 1625-1645, Third session - 1645-1830.
A bumper to end the over! Good change in length by Ishant. Lyon though ducks under it.
OHHH! This one pitches and then moves away from around off, Lyon goes for a loose drive but gets beaten. Head does the right thing by walking up to him and having a word with the offie.
On the pads again, it is worked towards square leg for a run. Into the 70s now is Head.
The rain is back! However, for now the umpires are happy to continue.
Back of a length around off, it is kept out.
Nicely played! Easy pickings for a batsman of Head's class as it was on middle and on a fuller length. It is flicked through mid-wicket and a couple taken.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Trademark Bumrah! A yorker around middle and leg. Lyon just about manages to get bat on it. He gets an inside edge onto his pads. An appeal follows but the umpire is not interested.
Goes fuller this time, Lyon strokes it to mid on. A good looking shot for no runs though.
WIDE! Another bumper, this time though it is too high and a wide signaled.

EDGY FOUR! First boundary of the day and these are handy runs for Australia. Trail below 40 now. Good length around off, Lyon tries to defend but the ball takes an outside edge and goes down to the vacant third man region. Boundary.
BEATEN! Lyon once again hangs his bat out to a delivery he can leave. The ball though whizzes past the outside edge.
Good length again on off, Lyon strokes it to covers.
On the shorter side but outside off, Lyon evades it easily.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller on middle, Head times it to mid on.

Top shot but it still does not get to the boundary. Deserved four that one. Full and on off, Lyon drives it square on the off side. Ashwin gives it a chase, the ball slows down as it nears the rope. Three taken.
Length again but it is outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Slightly straighter again, Head works it around the corner and takes a single.
Back of a length around off, the batsman works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Ishant Sharma to continue.
Attacks the stumps this time and Lyon strokes it to mid on.
BEATEN! A shot which Lyon could have avoided. Length ball outside off, Nathan has a feel for it and gets beaten.
We are back after the delay! Nathan Lyon is the new batsman, he will be on strike and Bumrah has 2 balls to go in this over. Here we go...
Update 12.14 pm local -  Play to begin in 16 minutes and Lunch to be taken at 1.30 pm local. So we will have an hour of play in this session, weather permitting that is.

Update 11.49 am local - Scratch the last update. We really got too hopeful after watching the covers getting dragged off. The rain has returned. Seems it's going to be a stop-start day. Really annoying.
Update 11.46 am local - The rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. The pitch cover though stays as it is. Won't be long before the play resumes. Stay with us.

Update 11.33 am local - And with that wicket, the heavens have opened up yet again. Nathan Lyon was about to come out but the umpires have decided to call for covers. The players head out to the pavilion. It's been that kind of a morning. Let's hope the rain eases out soon. Stay tuned for more updates.

OUT! Spot on bowling, Bumrah. Great execution, it's wider, it's fuller and Starc falls for it. Jasprit provides width and Starc's eyes lit up. The Australian number 9 tries to go big, swings his bat hard but only manages a thick outside edge behind to Pant. The Indians are celebrating. Early success for them. Starc must be disappointed, he has the ability to bat and just needed to partner Head there. The deficit is 46 runs and any lead for the tourists on this surface will be handy.
On a length around off, Starc covers the line and defends it towards mid on.
Once again the length is on the shorter side around off, Starc keeps his weight on the back foot and pushes it out to covers.
Back of a length delivery around off, Head stands back and helps it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.

Edgy runs! This is on a length and around off, Head plays inside the line, he gets an outside edge through the slip cordon. The ball though stops as it reaches towards the fence. Three taken, trail now below 50.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Some visible drizzle in the air. Please rain gods, we beg you, please stay away...

BEAUTY! This is what they need to bowl on a consistent basis! Good length around off, it pitches and then moves away. Head is squared up as he tries to defend, the ball beats the bat, hits the thigh pad and goes towards gully.
200 up! Australia 'just' 50 shy now! On the pads, Starc fails to flick, the ball hits his pads and rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
A couple! Full and on off, Starc chips it over mid off, once again due to the overnight rain, the outfield is quite slow. Only a brace.
Slightly shorter in length around off, it is guided to point.
A good nut to end the over! Length around middle, it comes in with the angle. Starc tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and a run is taken.

Play and a miss! A loose shot by Starc, that is how he plays though. If it is up there, he will go for it. Full and outside off, Starc throws his bat at it with minimal foot movement. Luckily for him, he gets beaten.

Changes the angle and comes around the wicket. Lands it just ahead of a length. The batsman is not sure whether to come forward or play from the crease. Head tries to keep it out awkwardly but gets an inside edge down to fine leg. A single, his first run today.
Once again it is slightly shorter and the line is a touch straighter. Starc works it through square leg for a run.
Accurately hits the length again around middle, MS goes back and defends it onto the ground. Bumrah needs to bowl a touch fuller here, give the ball more chance to do its bit.
Back of a length, angling away from the batter. It zips off the surface. Starc stands tall and guides it to point.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.

First runs for today! A confident stroke that! It is a length ball around off, Starc punches it on the up past the diving fielder at mid off. The outfield ain't that fast though so the ball does not get to the boundary. Three taken.
Drags his length back a little, it once again moves away a touch. Due to the length though, Starc can adjust and guide it to point.

Does get some swing this time and it turns out to be a beauty of a delivery! Ishant once again slants it into the batsman at first. Starc has to play at it, as he tries to do so with a forward defense. The ball though pitches and moves away, beats the outside edge of Starc's bat.
Better! This is slightly ahead of a length around off, Starc pushes it back towards the bowler. Went at that with hard hands did Starc. No swing though for Ishant in the first three balls.
Another one down the leg side and once again Starc misses the flick. He is trying to swing it away from the left-hander but it is just going down with the angle.
No swing on the first delivery though. A loosener to begin with by Ishant. It is down the leg side, Starc misses the flick.

We are all set for the game to begin! The players make their way out along with the umpires. The Aussie batsmen, Travis Head and Mitchell Starc will resume their innings. Ishant Sharma to start the proceedings for India. It is cloudy here and that just might aid the bowlers. Let us see if there is some swing available...
Update 10.50 am local - Good news, folks! If there is no further rain, play is expected to start in around 25 minutes from now. Fingers crossed. Stay tuned...

The reserve umpire, Gerard Abood is giving an interview. He starts by saying the rain has stopped now, they are not sure if more is coming but they are not bothered about that at the moment. Mentions the umpires will make their way out in some time and assess the pitch and ground conditions. Informs the groundsmen have started doing their work. Ends by saying they can extend play by an hour today and also add half an hour to the rest of the days to make up for the lost time.

Rishabh Pant who is giving an interview says he is loving Australia at the moment. He feels the wickets here are good for stroke making. Mentions his father always wanted him to play cricket and he has been doing that since childhood. Further adds his dad was also a wicket-keeper. States he has had good performances in the domestic circuit due to which he is in the team. Admits debuting for India was the best feeling. Ends by saying he is still learning from MS Dhoni and it is an amazing feeling to play for the country.

Coming to how the game is poised - the visitors have their noses in front, by not a lot though. They would look to bundle the home side out quickly and hope for a decent lead. The hosts, on the other hand, would like to get as close as possible first and then try to surpass the Indian total. Travis Head, the local lad, will have to do the bulk of the scoring and the home side will hope, the tail can hang around with him. The 'moving day' should probably give us a fair idea to which way the match is heading.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of Day 3. We have bad news to begin with, the clouds here have opened up and the pitch is under cover at the moment. We would be having a DELAYED START. However, the weather is expected to clear out as the day progresses and let us hope we do not have to wait a lot.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Right then. 59 is the deficit. How much ever Australia make, this will still be a one-inning shootout. Whether Australia get a lead or not, India will have the advantage as the hosts will have to bat last on a turning wicket. How much can the home side add? Not much batting left. Join us on Saturday at 10.30 am local (0000 GMT) for all the action from Day 3. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

How many times have we seen Ravichandran Ashwin do well outside Asia? Today was one of those few occasions. He was the one who opened the floodgates, getting rid of Harris, Marsh and Khawaja in the space of 57 balls. That pegged the Aussies back and then later on, Bumrah and Ishant made further inroads. Mohammed Shami had an off day - he seemed to have hurt his shoulder and lost control totally.

Superlative bowling from India. They have bowled 88 overs, picked up 7 wickets and conceded runs at just over 2 an over. They were loose in the first session, not quite hitting the right lines but post Lunch, they hit their spot. They did not concede many easy runs and Australia had to work so hard that 250 looked like 400.

After some wayward bowling in the morning session, India bounced back post Lunch. Australia were reduced to 127/6 from 45/1 and a 50-run stand between Travis Head and Pat Cummins somewhat saved the face for the home side. The former is the key - the longer he bats, the closer Australia will get to India's total.

Talking about the day overall, Australia just had to come out for one ball, with Hazlewood getting rid of  Shami. But Ishant then gave India a terrific start, removing Finch on the third ball. There was a bit of a fight, from debutant Marcus Harris and Usman Khawaja, with a 45-run stand - but once that was broken, familiar problems grappled the Aussies.

India's day but Australia are hanging in there. After battling out two tough sessions, the final one seemed the easiest to bat with the ball getting softer. 74 runs came in 33 overs but three wickets were also lost.
And a back foot punch towards point to end the day. STUMPS ON DAY 2, AUSTRALIA TRAIL BY 59!
Much better and the crowd applauds. Full and around off, Head gets right behind the delivery, covers the line and defends.
Another play and a miss. Head seems very nervous. Shami is bowling a very good last over, just dangling the carrot. Full and outside off, TH looks to drive but misses.
Better. Leaves this one alone outside off.

Jaffa! That came back in a long way. On a length outside off, Travis looked to punch it through the off side but got beaten by the late movement. Could have left it alone. Just 4 balls remaining in the day...
Full and just outside off, Head defends watchfully.
Final over of the day then.
Down the leg side, TH tucks it fine for a run. The deficit is now 59.
Fuller in length this time, around off, Travis walks across and flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Another piece of information - even if Australia get bowled out in this over, which is technically difficult, India will not come out to bat tonight.
On a length around off, punched back to the bowler once more.
Very full, nice and straight, around off, Head walks forward into the shot and offers it respect.
Comes forward again and blocks.
Full and around off, solidly defended.
Comes in a long way from outside off, but is well wide to be left alone.
Short and wide outside off, slashed hard to deep point - just a single. Moves to 60, does Head.
On a length again, outside off, punched towards point.
Similar length to the first ball, punched to deep point for a single.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
FOUR! A useful boundary! A loosener from Shami, on a length wide outside off, Starc just angles his blade behind point and Ishant Sharma gives it up pretty early.
Mohammed Shami is back for a late burst. 14-5-45-0 so far. He has got 2 overs tonight.
'WAIT THERE!' yells TH as he gets across and pushes it back to Bumrah.
Outside off, a touch short, Travis slashes but misses.
A bouncer now, Head ducks.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
You sharp guys must have noticed but still informing - We are into extended time with around 4 overs left.
Around off, tight lines, solidly defended.
On a length around off, defended back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The straighter one, outside off, left alone.
Tossed up again, this time MS defends.

LEADING EDGE, SAFE! Starc is running out of patience. Full and outside off, Mitchel throws the kitchen sink at it and has a heave-ho. Is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and gets a leading edge. Luckily for him, it balloons over Ishant Sharma at backward point. Two runs taken.
Fuller in length, Starc gets a big stride forward to defend it to the off side.
Landed around middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, Travis misses out on a freebie.
Outside off, a touch short, a flash and a miss.
A touch short, punched back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a couple. The deficit is now 68.
Pushes this towards deepish mid on for a run.

WAS THAT A CHANCE? Perhaps. Full and around middle, Starc gets a big stride forward to defend. The ball bounces, takes the inside edge and goes to short leg who is late to react. Wrings his hand in pain as the batsmen take a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Head comes down the track and pushes it towards long off for a single. Looks like India felt that was pad first as Pant went up in an appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Interesting. Ravichandran Ashwin to share the second new ball.
On middle and off, punched towards cover.
Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Mitchell Starc comes in next at number 9, replacing Cummins. This could be all over in a jiffy.

OUT! LBW it is and Australia lose Cummins and a review. A lovely delivery from Bumrah with the new nut. Similar to how Jos Buttler had been dismissed in the England series recently. A length ball outside off, Cummins shoulders arms, thinking that it is wide enough to be left alone. But the ball darts back in off the seam and hits him on the back thigh. Bumrah appeals and umpire Nigel Llong raises his finger! Cummins has a chat with Head and then signals for the review. No point in checking for the impact as no shot was offered. Ball Tracking shows the ball to be hitting the stumps. Very good delivery to break a very good stand. Australia still trail by 73 but they are looking a lot better than what they were, an hour ago. Cummins, take a bow.
Plumb LBW! That looks dead. Cummins though, has taken it upstairs...
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump again.
A wide ball outside off, left alone.
THE SECOND NEW BALL HAS BEEN TAKEN. Not surprising at all. Around 8 overs left. Jasprit Bumrah to make the first use of it. 16-7-31-1 so far.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.

50-RUN STAND IS UP! Down the leg side, Cummins looks to defend but the ball spins in, takes the inside edge and rolls down the leg side. A single taken which brings about a warm applause from the crowd. A smile comes up on Cummins' face as well as he walks across after completing the run, to shake hands with his partner. Very good partnership.
Fuller in length, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Pat looks to defend but the ball spins in, takes the inside edge an hits him on the groin.
Full and around off, Cummins pads it towards leg gully. There is an LBW appeal which is turned down.
Back of a length outside off, punched towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller in length this time, driven back to the bowler. That should be the end of Vijay for the day.
Outside off, a tad short, punched back to the bowler.
Fullish, pushed past the bowler for a run.
Outside off, punched away for a single.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Cracking shot to bring the highest stand in this innings. The deficit is now 76. Short and outside off, Head goes back in a flash and cuts it behind point for a boundary!
Goes right back in his crease and blocks.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around off, Cummins goes back and works it right in front of short leg.
Tossed up around off, pushed back towards Ashwin.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes down the track and bunts it back to the bowler.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Full again, well kept out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

HOW DID THAT MISS THE STUMPS? Risky leave from Cummins. The ball is around off and Pat leaves it alone, thinking it will hit his pad and he cannot be adjudged LBW as the ball will spin down the leg side. The ball does spin in but it goes between bat and pad, nearly hits the leg stump and hits Pant's pads!
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Goes back and tucks it towards short fine leg for a quick single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, watchfully kept out.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Very full, around off, nicely kept out.
Outside off, left alone again.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, Head comes forward and then takes his bat away.
Comes down the track and blocks.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, Cummins leans into the shot and drives it through the covers for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FIFTY FOR HEAD! A crucial one and a valiant one at that. Just his second in Tests. He has battled hard and is trying to keep Australia in the contest. Gets there with a punch through the covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Well, well, well. A fifth bowler has been introduced with the second new ball around the corner. It is not Rohit Sharma. It is... MURALI VIJAY.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
More extra runs. This one spins a long way from outside off, Pat misses his flick and the keeper is unable to collect. Goes past leg gully as well and two byes result.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around leg, worked through square leg for a single.

HOW DID THAT MISS THE STUMPS? Ashwin nearly had his fourth there. Flighted outside off, Cummins came forward to defend, thinking that he had covered the line but the ball spun in, missed the outside edge and just eluded the left bail! Three byes taken towards fine leg.
Landed outside off, drifting in, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Wow, lovely straight drive. Growing in confidence, Head. Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Travis brings down a straight bat and thumps it down the ground for a beautiful boundary.
The line is straight and Travis turns it off his pads to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Crunching drive by Head and he is now 7 short of a half century. He leans into a length ball and drives it crisply through covers. Kohli puts in a dive to his left but it's outside his reach. A boundary results.
A length ball on off, shaping back in, Cummins tries playing straight but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller this time and drifting down the leg side, Head fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. They cross and it's given as a run. Maybe, some inside edge. Deficit is under 100 now.
Good length delivery angling back into the batsman from outside off, Head is solidly behind the line in defense.

Drinks break. Another 2-wicket hour for India as they are into the Aussie tail. However, the likes of Pat Cummins and Mitchell Starc are no mug with the bat. The current pair has batted with intent and is trying to be positive. India continue to be on the money with the ball and will love to wrap up the Australian innings before Stumps today. Let's see what happens next.
Floated outside off, pushed back off the front foot.
Tossed up ball spinning back in, Cummins goes back and helps it down in front of leg gully.
Presses forward and plays it with the spin to sweeper cover for one. 150 up for Australia, trailing by 100!
Flighted and on middle, Head prods forward to defend and it comes off the splice of the bat.
A touch short and on middle, Head moves inside the crease and defends it down watchfully.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Fractionally short but down the leg side, Cummins fails to work it off his pads.
A touch short in length around off, Head gets back and plays it with the angle of the bowler to deep mid-wicket. Another run added to the total.
On a length around off, Cummins pushes it with gentle hands through point for one.
Well played. Short in length and outside off, Travis keeps his weight on the back foot and steers it through backward point for a run.
Fullish and moving back into the batsman, Head tries to play straight but it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls to mid on.
Angling down the leg side, Cummins fails to flick and it goes off his pads behind square leg for a leg bye.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
Head has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Head lunges and defends it back.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Flighted and wide outside off, left alone.
Lovely delivery, drifting in from around middle, Head fails to read it as he goes back to defend. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Short and wide outside off, Head rocks back and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Gentle hands. On a length and outside off, Cummins taps it to the left of the point fielder and crosses for a hesitant single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Cummins draws forward and defends it near his front pad.
Straighter in line, Head works it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
In the channel outside off, Head allows it through to the keeper.

Fuller in length outside off, Head drives it through covers and Kohli gives it the chase. Shami also puts in a run from mid off and does well to pull it back. He, then, parries it to his skipper who slips a bit while returning the throw. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Flatter and shorter around off, Pat goes back and plays it down in front of square on the off side.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Tossed up ball outside off, Cummins tries to defend it off his front foot but gets an outside edge wide of first slip for a couple.
Off spinner, landing outside off and turning back in, Cummins hits it from the back foot to covers.
Slower through the air, around leg, Head gets back and nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Stays back to tap it down towards point for a run.

FOUR! A good positive shot from Head. Sharma spreads a length delivery wide outside off, Travis with a superb hand-eye coordination crunches it through extra cover. Very limited footwork but good outcome.
A little short and on middle, Head goes back and defends it down safely.
In the channel outside off, left alone by Travis.
FOUR! That's his strength! He receives a short delivery outside off and exercises his arms. Really packs a punch and sends it screaming through point for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Head punches it off his back foot to covers.
Short and down the leg side, Head stands back and pulls it behind square leg for a run.
Too full and on middle, Head flicks it off his pads to square leg.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shortish on middle, defended back again.
Flighted and full on middle, Head defends it back off the front foot.
Sliding down the leg side, Head gets back to work it away but misses.
Pat Cummins walks in next with Australia trailing by 123 runs. Ravichandran Ashwin is also brought back into the attack, for the first time in this session.

OUT! Edged and gone! Beautiful delivery by Ishant. He was probing around the off stump line and eventually gets the better of the Aussie skipper. Just lands it on a length around off, Paine has to play the line as he tries to defend. But to his bad luck, the ball nips away ever so slightly to gather a faint outside edge. Pant makes no mistake and India are into the Australian tail now. 50th Test wicket for Ishant against Australia, only the second team against whom he has achieved this feat.
Hits the deck hard and bowls in a shortish ball on off, Paine rocks back and defends it towards the bowler.
Alters his length and digs in a short delivery just around off, Paine sways away from the line.
On and around off, served on a length, Tim is forward as he pushes it to covers.
Identical to the last delivery, once again the Aussie skipper is firm and forward in defense.
Fullish and on middle, angling in, Paine defends it by cleanly.
Ishant Sharma is back on.
Naahhh... Bumrah thinks differently. He eyes a yorker but ends up serving a low full toss on middle, Head clips it through wide mid on. Ashwin gets his hands to hit and saves two runs for his side.
Once again there is a nice movement back into the left-hander, Head gets behind the line and punches it in the direction of the bowler. Watch out for the away swinger, Travis!
Movement back into the batsman from a length outside off, Head does well to play it late as he keeps it out to covers.
A touch short and on middle, Travis works it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Again a length delivery on off, Travis mistimes his off drive to mid off.
Lands it on a length around off, from 'round the wicket, Head pushes it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Too full and around off, it's pushed down the ground but the mid on fielder cuts it off.
Paine has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Better this time. Presents the full face of the ball and middles his forward defensive shot.
A little bit of inward movement from a length outside off, Paine prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Nicely played! This was the shot that Peter Handscomb probably attempted but edged. Width on offer outside off, Tim camps back and guides it past gully for a boundary.
On a good length and around off, Paine defends it by covering the line of delivery.
A delightful cover drive by Head but he finds the cover fielder.
A single after 3 overs. Fullish and on middle, Paine flicks it in the gap at square leg for a run. The Aussie skipper is off the mark.

Incredible delivery! Bumrah hurls it on a good length just around off. Paine tries his best to defend by getting forward but the ball changes its direction after hitting the deck and moves away to beat the outside edge.
Hint of reverse there as Bumrah gets it to curl back into the batsman from around off. Paine just gets his bat down in time and digs it out off the inner edge.
Angles in a length ball around off, Tim defends it off his front foot.
Width on offer outside off, Paine taps it down to point. Early loud call of 'wait in' from the Aussie skipper and then he shouts no as the ball goes to the fielder.
Pitches it up and around off, Travis presses forward and drives it straight to mid off.
Lands it on a length and around off, Head covers the line and defends it with gentle hands.
Fuller and on middle, flicked across the line off the pads but straight to mid on.
Slips a good length delivery down the leg side, Head tries to get some wood behind it but fails.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Head rocks back and punches it to extra cover.
Shout for a catch! A very full delivery outside off, Paine tries to dig it out but misses. Pant collects the ball, they all appeal but the umpire disagrees.
Too full and on off, angling in, Paine defends it near his back pad. Slight appeal from the Indians as they thought it hit the pad first but nothing from the umpire.
A length ball angling back into the right-hander outside off, Paine covers the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Tim Paine's turn to bat.

OUT! Bumrah strikes this time! Handscomb is out of here. He tried hard in the middle but never looked convincing at the crease. A shortish length delivery has been delivered outside off, Handscomb leans back inside the crease with the intention to run it down to third man. But he fails to middle his shot and edges it into the mitts of Pant. The 33-run stand is broken and the Indian players are ecstatic. The deficit currently is 130.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Huge shout for an lbw! Bumrah spears in a deadly full ball on middle and leg, Handscomb falls over in his attempt to flick and misses the ball. He is thudded on the pads, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. His skipper looks at him and Jasprit gestures that it's going down leg. Good boy. We have seen many bowlers wasting reviews.
Fractionally short in length and around off again, Head pushes his weight on the back leg and defends it to the off side.
Around off on a length, Head defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Shortish and around off, defended from the crease to point. It rolled in the gap and they crossed for one.
Over the wicket for the right-hander, it's on a good length outside off, Handscomb pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Handscomb has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
First up Shami delivers it around off, Head works it around the corner and takes a single.
Mohammed Shami to continue from this end. Two slips in place as the bowler runs in from 'round the wicket...
Right on the money once again. Targets the off stump with a length ball and Peter blocks it yet again from the back foot.
Back of a length ball on off, Peter covers the line and blocks it back safely.
Switches to over the wicket for the right-hander and serves a length ball on off, Handscomb sticks inside the crease in defense.
A touch short on this occasion, on off, Head gets the opportunity to come behind the line as he turns it behind square leg for a run.
Once again the line is just around off and Travis is very solid in his forward defense.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman from 'round the wicket, it's on off and Head defends it by covering the line.

Welcome back for the final session. The Indians spread out onto the field. Who will start? Any guesses? No, it's not Ravichandran Ashwin. He gets a breather after bowling relentlessly from this end in the afternoon. Jasprit Bumrah to run in first up...
... DAY 2, FINAL SESSION ...

33 overs left in the day. Can India bowl Australia out in this session? It just seems a matter of a wicket against this brittle line-up before an implosion occurs. Join us back at 3.30 pm local (0500 GMT).

Australia lost Harris and Marsh either side of the break and then they got the big wicket in the form of Usman Khawaja, which has pegged them back. Head and Handscomb have had a few plays and misses but have managed to hang around, somehow taking the partnership to 30.

There is nothing much happening in the wicket but the Indian bowlers, combined with excellent discipline and some assistance from the Aussie batsmen in terms of lack of footwork and patience, have made it look like a wicket is always around the corner. Full marks to Ashwin for bowling unchanged but great improvement from the seamers after an ordinary opening session.
Another grinding session. 60 runs scored and 2 wickets lost in 28 overs. India have been relentless while the Aussies have been not that patient.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. TEA ON DAY 2, AUSTRALIA TRAIL BY 133!
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for three.

NOT OUT. There is a noise but that is not of wood. On a length down the leg side, Head looked to flick but missed. Pant collected and appealed but nothing much. Virat Kohli came charging in from second slip and was very confident, even asking his keeper, 'LOON KYA? LOON KYA?' Shami then told his skipper that the ball was far from the pad. He goes for the review and Hot Spot indicates a spot on the trousers. Waste of a review.
Ho ho! Has Kohli heard something here? He has confidently taken a review for a caught behind. None of the others seemed much interested. There was a noise...
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, well blocked out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, Head initially comes forward to defend but then opens the bat-face to push the ball towards point.
Goes back in his crease and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A short ball, down the leg side, Head looks to pull but misses. The ball goes off his body towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, dabbed behind point for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
NEARLY A WICKET NOW! Too loose from Peter. Short in length, yes. But not that wide outside off. PH flashes hard and gets a bottom edge which lands short of first slip.

FOUR! MURDERED! Stop the press! Australia have scored a boundary! A loosener from Shami, short and outside off, Handscomb likes that as it is a pressure reliever. Rocks back in a flash and pummels a pull through mid-wicket. The deficit is now 139. That is Handscomb's 5th boundary, taking him to 31.
Mohammed Shami is back on. 7-4-17-0 so far.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed back to the bowler.
Another instance of PH coming down the track, pushing it past a racing Virat Kohli at short mid-wicket, towards long on for a single. The partnership ambles to 20 from 74 balls.
Fired in on middle, Peter pushes it past short leg.
Once more Handscomb is down the track, pushing the ball towards the bowler.
Pushes this towards short mid-wicket.
Once again comes down the track, is nowhere near the pitch of the ball, looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
On middle and leg, worked behind square leg for a single.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Full and just outside off, moving away, Handscomb plays away from his body and pushes it towards a diving second slip.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and off, tucked behind square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. That is the end of the 50TH OVER OF THE INNINGS. The run rate is barely 2 runs an over.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a run.
Finally gets some worth for all his efforts. Jumps out and works it through square leg for a single.
Is out of the crease for the third time in a row, pushing the ball to the off side.
Comes down the track, gets a full toss but misses out. Whips it straight to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Handscomb jumps out of the crease and defends.
Darts back in off the seam from outside off, on a length, PH works it behind square leg for a single.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.

That is a beauty! Perfect setup from Ishant. He kept moving the ball away, away, away and then got this one to tail in. The length was full and that enticed Peter into the drive but he missed it completely.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
On middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single. The deficit is now 149.

JUST SHORT! Dangerous from Handscomb. He jumps out, looking to drive, is not quite to the pitch of the ball and is not quite able to control his shot. Nearly spoons a catch to Cheteshwar Pujara at short extra cover.

Fraction straighter, outside off, Peter looks to defend but is defeated by the extra bounce. The ball spins in, past the inside edge, hits the pad and lobs to short leg with yells of a catch and an appeal.
Comes out now and blocks it safely.
Full and outside off, Handscomb lunges to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. A massive appeal ensues, only to be turned down.
Jumps out, gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it towards cover.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single. 100 UP FOR AUSTRALIA. The deficit is still 150.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A length ball, around middle, watchfully blocked out.
Full and straight, pushed towards wide mid on.
Much fuller this time, coming in, Peter awkwardly pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Slightly fuller this time, outside off, Handscomb allows it through.
Starts with a wide delivery outside off, shorter in length, left alone.
Ishant Sharma is back on. 9-4-13-1 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Now Handscomb uses his feet and pushes it towards mid on for a run.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and pushes it through mid off for a single.
On middle and off, defended from the crease.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length outside off, moving away, TH is squared up as he looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge behind point and the batsmen take a single. The stand moves to 10.
Landed just outside off, Travis takes his bat out of harm's way.
Full and wide outside off, Head leans and drives it straight to deep point.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A length ball, down the leg side, helped through square leg for a couple.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and straight, darted in, watchfully blocked out.
FOUR! A rare bad ball. Short and outside off, Head rocks back and cuts it through point. Mohammed Shami dives to his left but the ball goes through.
Beautiful drift, coming in, then moving away, pushed towards the off side.
Jumps out but is nowhere near the pitch of he ball. Somehow manages to push it towards cover.
Full and around off, Handscomb lunges and looks to flick but the ball drifts in, takes the inside edge and just evades short leg. A single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off this time, the southpaw blocks.
Landed outside off, Travis shoulders arms.
On a length around off, angling in, Head hops and defends it to the leg side.

Drinks break. Two wickets in the first hour post Lunch and India are beginning to gain the upper hand on this Test match. Both the experienced batsmen, Shaun Marsh and Usman Khawaja, have been dismissed and the inexperienced lot is exposed. They still trail by 162 runs and would have to bat really well to get anywhere near the Indian total. Ravichandran Ashwin has been among the wickets but the tourists will hope for their pacers to succeed as well.
Rocks back to a shortish delivery and slaps it to sweeper cover for one. Head is off the mark.
Strides forward to a full ball and blocks it safely.
Flatter and on off, blocked off the back foot.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Head has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and outside off, Head rocks back and then allows it through to the keeper.
Angles back in from around off, Handscomb defends it from the middle of the bat.

Play and a miss! Bumrah bowls this one from wide of the crease and angles it on a length around off. Peter stays back to defend the trajectory but it straightens off the seam to beat the outside edge.
Good length delivery on off, Handscomb remains on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Gets across and blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Around that off stump again, solid in defense is Handscomb.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
India going for the kill. Jasprit Bumrah has been brought back on. 9-4-24-0 so far. The visitors would do well to learn from past mistakes where they have allowed the tail to wag.
Much better. It's outside off and left alone by Head.

Caught in a tangle. A late decision to leave this delivery. It's around off and spinning away, Travis should have been forward but stays back and makes a leave. The ball wasn't too far away from the outside edge.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Head draws forward in defense.
Travis Head arrives in the middle.

OUT! Khawaja has gloved it! Huge breakthrough for India as they get rid of the set batsman. Ashwin hunts down his third victim. Once again gets a good drift on his delivery and hurls it around off. Khawaja commits himself on the front foot as he leans forward to defend. But the ball spins away a bit to beat the outside edge of his bat. Although there is some sound as it goes past him and Pant after takes a fine catch lets out an appeal. Umpire Dharmasena shakes his head and Virat Kohli takes the DRS. The replays roll in and first it shows that Ashwin has not overstepped. Now, Hot Spot is employed which detects a tiny spot on Khawaja's gloves. That's enough for the third umpire to overrule the onfield decision. Usman has to walk back after playing a 125-ball knock. Deficit for Australia is 13 more than 150. In trouble. The devil's number strikes for the hosts.
Huge shout for a caught behind. Umpire Dharmasena shakes his head. The Indian players are very sure and Virat Kohli wastes no time in reviewing it.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Sliding down the leg side, Khawaja gets back and turns it fine down the leg side for a run.

Shout for an lbw! Shami gets this delivery to tail back into the batsman. Handscomb fails to keep it out from the crease and is rapped on the pads. The bowler appeals but it's going down and hence the umpire shakes his head.
Beaten! Hurls in a length ball around off, gets it to move away a bit, Peter pushes inside the line and misses.
Around off on a length, Handscomb defends it from within the crease.
In the region outside off, left alone by Peter.
Almost drags it on! On a length around off, Handscomb goes hard at it, tries to force through the line but it takes the bottom edge before going behind towards the slip cordon.
A touch short in length around off, Peter punches it off his back foot to covers.
Floated and on middle, Khawaja gets back and defends it with a straight bat. Applying himself superbly, Usman.
Flatter and fuller on off, defended off the front foot.
Turn and bounce from around off, Khawaja leaves it again and Pant collects it near his face.
Tossed up and outside off, left alone by Usman.
Edgy! Turning away from the batsman outside off, Khawaja tries to drive through covers but it takes the outside half of his bat and goes to point.
Flatter and shorter on off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Nicely played! An overpitched delivery on the pads, Peter leans across and clips it with beautiful timing through square leg for a boundary. First convincing boundary from his bat. Right from the middle.
Solidly defended. Gets behind the line of the delivery this time and dead-bats it.

Beaten all ends up! Peter is extremely lucky not to edge it. Shami slants in a length ball around off, Handscomb sticks back to defend it with a straight bat but it nips away a bit to beat the outside edge. There was a lot of movement after it went past the bat.
Full and around off, angling in, Handscomb defends it off his front foot.

FOUR! No half measures there. Width on offer outside off, a touch on the shorter side, Handscomb camps back and slashes hard at it. It speeds off the bottom half of his bat and goes through the gap at backward point.

TOP EDGE! FOUR! Risky but it's rewarded. Shami digs in a short delivery around off and Handscomb takes on the challenge to pull it across the line. There is some extra bounce which catches the top half of his willow and flies over the keeper for a boundary.
Goes flatter through the air around off, skidding back in, Khawaja immediately goes on the back foot and blocks it back safely.
Loopy ball, around off and turning away, Khawaja outside edges his attempted cover drive towards point.
Fuller and on off, defended back off the front foot by Usman.
Turn and bounce on this occasion and Ashwin bowls it slower through the air. Handscomb sticks back and turns it past short leg for a run.
A touch short and around off, Peter picks the length early and defends it from the back foot.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Khawaja gets back and cuts it through the line. Fails to middle his shot properly but still it goes through the gap at cover-point for a run.
Hurls in a good length ball close to the off stump line, Peter stays back to tap it down towards point.
Nice and firm inside the crease.  A length ball outside off, Peter brings down a straight bat and pushes it down to mid off.
Strides forward to a full ball and drives it through the line. Once again fails to pierce the gap on the off side.
FOUR! Streaky boundary! Shami lands a length ball just around off, Handscomb tries playing it with a straight bat but gets a thick outside edge through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary.
Runs in and bowls a length delivery outside off, Peter allows it through.
Starts his spell with a fuller length delivery outside off, Handscomb drives but finds the cover fielder.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
Tossed up ball and wide outside off, it's left alone by Usman to end the over.
Slower this time, full and around off, Khawaja presses forward in defense.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched from the back foot but straight to covers.
Flighted and outside off, Khawaja defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Full and flighted around leg, Usman leans forward and defends it to the leg side.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and drives it down the ground through mid on. He waits for the ball to go past Shami and then picks up a couple of runs.
On a length and around off, Peter defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Pitches it up and around off, Handscomb plays a confident looking drive but finds the fielder at extra cover.
Slips a full ball down the leg side, Handscomb tries flicking but misses.
Angles in a full length around off, Peter gets on the front foot in defense.
Good length delivery outside off, holding its line, Handscomb shoulders arms.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Works it off his pads to mid-wicket for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Uses his feet again and pushes it towards mid off.
A piece of paper is found flying on the field. From where it came? Ashwin like a true gentleman just picks it up and hands it over to the umpire.
Lunges to a full delivery this time and blocks it near his front pad.
Flighted full ball on off, Peter walks down the track and defends it back.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Serves it in the zone outside off, the southpaw makes an easy leave.
This one is angled into the batsman from 'round the wicket. It's on middle and leg, Usman plays it off his pads to wide mid on.
Lands it on a length and just outside off, Khawaja keeps his weight on the back leg as he defends it with an angled bat.
Angles in a good length ball on off, Khawaja presents a straight bat in defense.
Bowls it wide outside off, it's left alone by Khawaja.
Handscomb dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Shortish and outside off, Usman cuts it off his back foot to point for a run. Moves to 26 after facing 100 balls. Digging in.
Flighted and just outside off, not turning much, Khawaja lets it through. That wasn't too far away from the off pole.
Tossed up ball on off, Usman is back to defending after a minor break in concentration on the last ball.

Edged but just wide of Rahane! A lovely teasing delivery by Ashwin. He bowls it around off and gets it to spin away. Khawaja is lured into the drive but he gets an outside edge. It travels just wide of the diving first slip fielder for a couple.
Slower through the air and it lands full around off. Khawaja decides to defend it off his back foot. Should have been forward.
On a driving length outside off, Peter once again lets it through to Pant.
Lands it on a length and outside off, holding its line, Handscomb shoulders arms.
A straighter line delivery has been turned behind square leg for a single. The Indians are quite chirpy now.
Ishant oversteps this time and bowls it on off, Usman has blocked it from the crease. No ball called.
This one is in the channel outside off, Khawaja makes a comfortable leave.
Another back foot defense by Khawaja. He is quite assured playing the shorter deliveries.
Back of a length delivery on off, Khawaja defends it off his back foot.
Peter Handscomb is the number 5 batsman.

OUT! Drags it on! Not for the first time in this Test match that a batsman has got out while attempting to drive away from his body. Excellent start to the session for India. They have managed to dismiss a big batsman from the opposition camp. A pretty much nothing delivery by Ashwin. He just puts it out on a driving length outside off and plays on the patience of the batsman. Marsh's front foot just goes straight through as he tries to drill it through covers. But it takes a massive inside edge and disturbs the stumps behind. Shaun's ordinary form against India at home continues. Australia trail by 191 runs and are in some trouble.
Fires one in on middle and leg, Khawaja works it behind square leg for one.
Quicker this time, it's flat and short outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.
Another flighted delivery dropping full on off, Khawaja presses forward in defense.
Loopy full ball on off, Usman defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Shaun tickles it off his pads behind square leg for a single.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. The players are making their way out in the centre. An important passage of play this for both sides. Ravichandran Ashwin to continue from this end. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

To be honest, the Indian bowlers were not at their best. Their lines were inaccurate and they wasted the new ball when it was moving. By far, Ishant Sharma was the best out of the lot while Ravichandran Ashwin was decent in his 8-over spell. He although didn't get the same kind of purchase from the surface that Nathan Lyon obtained on Day 1. The visitors will be hopeful of their pacers getting into the act post Lunch whereas Australia will be wishing for a big partnership between the most experienced batsmen in their batting line-up. Who will succeed? Do join us in a short while to find out.

A mixed session for both teams! Australia just took one ball to wrap up the Indian innings early in the morning. In reply, they suffered an early setback when Finch got his furniture shattered by Ishant in the first over but after that, the pair of Usman Khawaja and Marcus Harris steadied things with a 45-run stand. The debutant showed good skill and temperament in his little knock before getting caught at silly point off the bowling of Ravichandran Ashwin.
Full and drifting down the leg side, Khawaja clips it neatly off his pads through backward square leg and picks up a couple of runs. That will be Lunch on Day 2.
Straighter in line again, angling down, Marsh fails to get bat on ball yet again as he tries to flick. It goes off his pads to backward square leg and they pinch a leg bye.

Four leg byes! Ishant errs again and delivers a length ball down the leg side, Marsh once more in this over fails to flick and it takes his pads before speeding away past the diving keeper for a boundary at fine leg. Follow-on avoided by Australia, if you doubted their batting.
Leading edge but safe! Ishant darts in a length ball on middle and leg, Shaun tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It takes the leading edge but goes safely to extra cover.
Shortish and on off, Usman turns it in the gap on the leg side for a run. 50 up for Australia.
Steams in from 'round the wicket and angles a length delivery down the leg side. Shaun fails to flick and Pant deflects it down to fine leg for a leg bye.
Ishant Sharma returns to bowl the final over before Lunch.
Loopy and full around off, Khawaja shimmies down the track and drives it through the line to covers. A little uppish but out of danger.
Sliding down the leg side, Marsh tries to sweep but misses. It goes behind off his pads for a leg bye.
Once again Marsh presses forward in defense.
Loopy and on off, Shaun is on the front foot in defense.
Fullish and on middle, flicked across the line but straight to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle, Marsh goes on the back foot and defends it towards mid on.
Outside off, left alone to end another maiden over by Bumrah.
Another drive off the front foot but it goes straight to the mid off fielder.
Serves this up and outside off, Usman drives it off his front foot to wide mid off.

In the channel outside off, good probing line by Jasprit, Usman keeps his patience and makes a leave. He's following Pujara's footsteps. Spending time in the middle, keeping his calm and waiting for the bowler to err.
Back of a length ball on off, Usman goes on the back foot and taps it down towards point.
Lands it on a length just outside off, Khawaja watches the line closely and then decides to leave it alone.
Another front foot defense by Shaun to end the over.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.

Ashwin drags his length short outside off, Usman goes back and cuts it to the left of the point fielder. They cross for a brisk single. Good running between the wickets, you don't normally associate this with these two.
Full and flighted on off, defended again off the front foot.
Khawaja has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Marsh turns it off his pads in the direction of short fine leg and opens his account with a single.
Outside off, left alone for the sixth time in a row. End of a good accurate over by Bumrah. He just kept on probing in the corridor of uncertainty.
Puts it on a good length just outside off, Usman is showing good composure in leaving those.
A zippy delivery, landing on a length outside off and skidding through, Khawaja takes a stride forward and lets it through.
Third ball in a row is in the zone outside off. The southpaw keeps on leaving. Doesn't want to take any unnecessary chance minutes before Lunch.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Khawaja guards his stumps and allows it through to the keeper.
Bowls a length delivery in the region outside off, Usman leaves it.
Quicker and shorter on off, Shaun defends it off his back foot. A wicket maiden for Ash!
Marsh has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy and outside off, stroked off the front foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Fullish and flatter on middle, it's forced down to mid on.
Tossed up ball on off, Shaun defends it off his front foot.
Shaun Marsh is the new batsman.

OUT! Harris falls! Ashwin breaks the 45-run stand. The debutant departs after impressing in his little knock. It's a beautifully tossed up delivery by Ashwin. He gets it to drift into the batsman and lands full around off. Harris presses forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball pops out off his pads and Vijay takes the simplest of catches at silly point. Finally a breakthrough for India and they are looking relieved in their celebration. They had to work hard for it.
A delivery in the channel outside off, Khawaja has nothing to do with it.
Good news for India! Mohammed Shami is back on the field.
Sharp delivery, a touch short around off, Khawaja gets behind the line and gives it a dead-straight-bat treatment.
Hurls in a length delivery in the zone outside off, Khawaja makes a watchful leave on this occasion.
Edgy! Bumrah serves it on a back of a length outside off, Khawaja sticks back inside the crease as he pushes inside the line. It takes the outer half of the bat but doesn't carry to gully.
Back of a length delivery on off, Khawaja stays back-footed and defends it down.
In the right channel, Usman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Quicker and flatter on off, extra bounce this time, Marcus defends it down safely.
Drifting into the batsman around off and turning away, Harris stays back and makes a leave at the last moment.
Floated ball on off, Harris prods forward in defense.

FOUR! Shot! Tossed up ball outside off, Harris leans forward and flat-bats it through extra cover. Rahul gives it the chase and Ishant from long off also runs across to his right. The former probably pulls out thinking the latter will get to it. But no, the ball has gone to the fence.
Shortish and on middle, Harris gets back inside the crease and defends.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended off the back foot by Harris.
Angles a length ball on off, Khawaja defends it on the leg side. Maiden!
Fractionally short and outside off, Khawaja has nothing to do with it.
Back of a length ball on middle, Usman goes back and taps it down on the leg side.
Another watchful leave to a delivery outside off.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Short in length on off, defended from the back foot.
Mohammed Shami has left the field. Clearly something is wrong with his right shoulder. Jasprit Bumrah replaces him in the attack.
Loopy and just around off, Harris initially shapes up for the sweep shot but then makes a leave at the last moment. Once again his bat moved out of the way as if he is swatting a fly.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.

FOUR! Fine footwork, excellent shot. Ashwin gives it flight and serves it on a fuller length outside off, Harris wears his skate and powers it over the bowler's head. Looks like a confident young man.
Shorter this time, Harris blocks it from the crease.
Just short of silly point. Loopy and full around off, Harris is forward in defense and it goes a shade uppishly to Vijay.
Flatter and around off, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.
Khawaja has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Shami is feeling some discomfort near his shoulder area and the physio comes out.
On a length and wide outside off, Khawaja lets it be to the keeper.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
This one is angled into the batsman, the line is too straight and Harris helps it behind square leg for a run, first off Shami.
Digs in a short delivery outside off, Harris sways away from the line.

Prashant - 'Yawnnnnnn.... ball not swinging, wickets not coming, boundaries not coming, batsmen not running, score not moving... when Harris was on 12, Khawaja was on 17. Now Harris is on 17 and Khawaja is still on 17. My eyelids are drooping...' @Prashant... good night, mate. Though a little bit of patience might help. A wicket will change everything.
Full and flighted around leg, Usman lunges to work it on the leg side but it spins away a touch and takes the leading edge. The ball goes rolling to short cover.
Shortish on off again, punched off the back foot to short cover.
A touch short in length around off, skidding back in, Khawaja goes on the back foot in defense.
Tossed up ball outside off, Harris hits it wide of the cover fielder and scampers across to the other end.
Floated off spinner on middle, Harris is forward again as he defends it to the leg side.
Too full in length on off, Marcus defends it off his front foot.
Switches to over the wicket and lands it on a fuller length around off, Khawaja slices his drive a bit towards the point fielder.
On a length and outside off, Usman strides forward and across before making a leave.
Good length ball on off, blocked off the back foot.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Khawaja plays away from his body and pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
A length ball on off, angling in from 'round the wicket, Usman defends it off his back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Prods forward to a full ball and defends it to silly point.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Loopy and outside off, Harris lunges and swats it over covers for a couple of runs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up ball on off, Harris goes on the back foot in defense.
Another delivery wide outside off, Khawaja lets it be to end the over.
Pitches it full and wide outside off, Khawaja isn't chasing it.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Drags his length short and bowls it on off, Khawaja goes back pulls it on the leg side. Finds mid-wicket.
Shami angles in a length ball on off, Khawaja keeps it out to the off side from the outer half of his blade.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Oohhh...that nearly clipped the off bail. Ashwin bowls his variation delivery. Lands it around off and gets it to skid back in from outside off. Harris stands back inside the crease and makes a leave. Pant collects it close to the off pole and his reaction says it all. Too close for comfort.
Quicker one on off, blocked from the back foot.
Loopy and full around off, Harris is forward as he chips it just over mid off for a couple of runs.
Flatter and on off, defended from the crease by Harris.
Flighted and full around off, Marcus prods forward and blocks it safely.
Tossed up ball on off, Harris defends it by covering the line.
Double bowling change. It's time for some off spin from Ravichandran Ashwin. A slip and silly point in place.

Drinks break. It's been a cautious start by Australia after losing Aaron Finch in the first over. The Indian pacers have not hit their straps yet as they have been quite inconsistent with their lines. Would like to improve in the next hour. The hosts would be hoping for a big partnership between the current pair.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drops it on a length and outside off, zipping off the surface, Khawaja covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Good length delivery on off, angling down the leg side, Khawaja plays it off his pads to backward square leg.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Wrong line. It's short but going down the leg side. Harris lets it be and Pant tries to collect it with a dive to his right. Only manages to parry it towards fine leg and they cross for a bye. The Indian keeper's account is open now. He gave away quite a few byes in England.
First bowling change made by Virat Kohli. Mohammed Shami has the ball in his hand. He will operate from 'round the wicket...
FOUR! Easy pickings! Bumrah drifts down the leg side, Khawaja picks it off his pads and deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Fullish and on off, Khawaja gets on the front foot in defense.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Khawaja gets back and defends it down.
Shortish on off, defended from the crease to the off side.

Bumrah switches to over the wicket and angles away a good length delivery outside off. Khawaja stays back and punches it through covers for a couple of runs. Marcus Harris turns for the third run but Usman shows no interest.
The line is too straight from Bumrah, he hasn't bowled to a consistent line from 'round the wicket angle. Khawaja glances it through square leg for a couple of runs.
A back foot defense on this occasion by the debutant to end the over.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Marcus gets on the front foot and defends it solidly.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman from outside off, Harris covers his stumps and then makes a leave.
Serves it on a length and outside off, this time Marcus with a calm head allows it through to the keeper.
No ball called for overstepping! Back of a length ball on middle, Khawaja turns inside the crease and taps it down to square leg.
Beauty by Ishant! Angles it into the batsman on a good length outside off and gets it to straighten just a hint, Harris tries to force it through the line and gets beaten.
Pitches it up and outside off, gets the batsman driving as Marcus eases it down the ground through mid off for a couple.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Straighter in line, Harris works it behind square leg for a brace.

FOUR! A late thought to play at it. Bumrah ups his pace and lets out a lethal short delivery around off at 147.7 kph. Harris initially tries to sway away from the line but at the very last moment, he has a change of mind. Plays at it with an angled bat and places his shot through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary. First of the Australian innings.
Marcus has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

A sharp delivery, angling into the batsman at 146.5 kph, Harris tries working it around but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler and keeper appeal, the umpire isn't interested. Going down also too high.

Appeal for a caught behind! The Indian slip cordon is shouting on top of their tonsils but Jasprit Bumrah gestures that he heard nothing. Umpire Dharmasena is also shaking his head. It's a delivery outside off, shaping away just a touch, Harris is lured into the drive but fails to middle his shot. Pant collects the ball, they all appeal barring the bowler but nothing doing. The replays detect no outside edge.
Fullish and on off, Usman is forward in defense. So, he kept the batsman waiting for a delivery on middle and leg.
Once again sticks to the line outside off. It's on a good length and Khawaja leaves it alone.

Extra bounce from a length outside off, Khawaja does well to block it with a loose bottom hand. With a leg gully in place, it's a bit strange that Ishant has not tried anything in the middle and channel.
Sharma keeps probing in the channel outside off, Khawaja shoulders arms. It's been a watchful going from Australia after the early fall of Aaron Finch.
Fullish and outside off, this one shapes back in after landing, Usman takes his front leg forward and then makes a leave.
Full and outside off, shaping away, Khawaja allows it through to the keeper.
The length is a little bit short around off and the line is such that Khawaja gets inside it nicely. He then tucks it through backward square leg and retains strike with a run.
Khawaja has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This one is on a driving length outside off, holding its line, Khawaja lets it through to the keeper.
A touch short and around off, Usman jumps on the back foot and plays it on the leg side.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Usman defends it off his back foot.
Ripper! Bumrah pulls his length back a bit and hurls it just around off. Khawaja stays back to push inside the line but it shapes away to beat the outside edge.
Full in length, angling in the direction of the off stump, Harris presses forward and presents a straight bat in defense.
Lands it on a length just around off, straightening just a touch, Marcus defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Bouncer is served on the plate for the debutant. Harris ducks underneath it.

Good length ball on middle and off, some extra bounce there, Khawaja stands back and takes his bottom hand off the handle as he plays it on the leg side. The ball goes in the gap and they switch ends.
With a leg gully in place, Ishant tries to put doubts in Khawaja's mind. However, he bowls it full and outside off. Usman drives it in the gap at covers for a couple.

Edgy! Ishant lands it on a fuller length outside off and gets it to move away just a bit off the seam. Khawaja tries to defend it with soft hands but it takes the outside half of his bat before rolling to gully.
Angling into the batsman from around off, Harris hangs back in defense.
Good length ball on off, it's defended from the crease to the off side.
Serves it on and around off and angles it again into the southpaw. Harris is on the front foot as he defends it on the leg side.
It's on a length around off and is angling in, Khawaja eases it in the gap at mid-wicket and calls his partner through for a run.
On a good length and outside off, Khawaja gets back to cover the stumps and then makes a leave.
Bumrah speeds in from 'round the wicket and angles in a full length ball on off, Khawaja pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Fuller in length and outside off, Harris walks across the stumps a bit and then defends it by leaning forward.
Another delivery around off, on a good length, Harris is showing good technique as he blocks it safely to covers.
Good line and length from Ishant. He is keeping it just around off and making the batsman play. Marcus defends it by covering the line. He needs to watch out for the one that nips away.
Bowls it closer to the off stump line and makes the batsman play. Harris is on the front foot and defends it gently to the off side.
Pitches it up and outside off, curving away off the seam, Harris watches the line closely and then makes a leave. The way he took his bat away from the line reminds us of Steven Smith.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Strays on the pads for the umpteenth time in this over, Usman works it away through backward square leg. Ishant from fine leg cuts it off and they take a couple. A pretty ordinary first over by Bumrah.
Puts it on a length outside off, from 'round the wicket, Khawaja allows it through.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bumrah is once again down the leg side and Khawaja turns it off his hips to deep square leg for a couple.

Appeal for a catch! Not given. Another delivery by Bumrah down the leg side, Khawaja tries flicking but misses. There is some sound as it goes past him and Pant appeals after collecting the ball. Nothing from the umpire. The Hot Spot shows that it clipped the trouser of Usman.

This will make the debutant feel good about himself. Bumrah is on the pads first ball, Harris clips it in front of square leg with good timing. The ball however stops just before the rope and they take three runs.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the attack from the other end.
Ishant switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander. Lands it on a length outside off and gets it to shape away. Khawaja finds the line too wide to play at.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, another leave is made by Khawaja.
Bowls it on a good length and wide outside off, Khawaja allows it through.
Usman Khawaja is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Stumps are destroyed! What a cracking beginning for India! Excellent delivery by Ishant and it's aided by some poor choice of shot by Aaron. The tall Indian bowler serves it on a length and once again gets it to shape back in a bit. Finch tries to drive it through the line, his footwork ain't good enough and it catches some inside edge of his willow before going to clatter the stumps. The Indian skipper as usual is all pumped up. A perfect start for India. Stumps flying and as a fast bowler you just love that sight.

Shout for an lbw! This one is identical to the last delivery and only difference was that it nipped back in a shade. Finch once again decides to leave it alone but is surprised by the inward movement. It raps him on the pads, they appeal but it has not come back in enough, feels the umpire.
Ishant Sharma begins with a good length delivery in the channel outside off, holding its line, Finch takes a stride forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
